name: Airline Empire: Game Center achievements and leaderboards
description: Airline Empire's first update brings Game Center to a deep airline management game for iPhone and iPad. Seventeen achievements follow the milestones players already celebrate, from a first flight and first profitable month to an intercontinental route, a million passengers and an airline empire. Three leaderboards rank passengers flown, network size and fleet — never money, so a player's standing reflects how they built their airline rather than which scenario they started. Game Center is entirely optional: nothing in the game waits on it, and sign-in is offered only when the player asks. The update also makes the everyday more direct: fares and aircraft are one tap from every route, VoiceOver lands on the section a player jumps to, and briefing and rival screens say shared caveats once instead of on every row. No ads, energy meters, premium currency or paid shortcuts, as at launch.
helpfulDetails: Native SwiftUI for iPhone and iPad; campaigns run on device with no game account and no developer tracking. Game Center adds no rules: every achievement is a milestone the game already awards. Leaderboards rank passengers, network and fleet rather than cash. Accessibility improvements include VoiceOver focus after route shortcuts. Developer: Isac Molin, Sweden.
